typography.heading_strategy: High contrast, crisp edges. No soft rounded fonts. Use font-semibold and tracking-tight for card headers.
typography.data_strategy: ALL dynamic numbers, prices, and percentages MUST use font-mono and tabular-nums utility class to prevent horizontal jittering when values change.

layouts.main_structure: h-screen flex overflow-hidden bg-[#131722] text-[#d1d4dc] font-sans
layouts.sidebar: w-64 flex-shrink-0 border-r border-[#2a2e39] bg-[#131722] hidden md:flex flex-col
layouts.header: h-16 flex items-center justify-between px-4 border-b border-[#2a2e39] bg-[#131722] sticky top-0 z-10
layouts.dashboard_grid: p-4 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4 overflow-y-auto

cards.base_classes: bg-[#1e222d] rounded-[4px] border border-[#2a2e39] p-4 flex flex-col
cards.header_classes: text-[#ffffff] text-sm font-semibold mb-4 flex items-center justify-between uppercase tracking-wider

tables.header: text-[#787b86] font-normal border-b border-[#2a2e39] pb-2 text-xs uppercase
tables.row: hover:bg-[#2a2e39] transition-colors duration-150 cursor-default border-b border-[#2a2e39]/50 last:border-0
tables.alignment: Left align text (tickers), Right align numerical values (prices, percentages)

buttons.icon_button: p-2 rounded-md hover:bg-[#2a2e39] text-[#787b86] hover:text-[#d1d4dc] transition-colors
buttons.primary_action: bg-[#2962ff] hover:bg-[#2962ff]/80 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded text-sm font-medium transition-colors

badges.up: text-[#26a69a] bg-[#26a69a]/10 px-2 py-1 rounded-[4px] text-xs font-mono tabular-nums
badges.down: text-[#ef5350] bg-[#ef5350]/10 px-2 py-1 rounded-[4px] text-xs font-mono tabular-nums

motion.hover_states: Subtle background color changes (#2a2e39) on table rows, sidebar items, and buttons.
motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out for all interactive elements. Avoid transform transitions on heavy data rows.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px solid #2a2e39 everywhere to separate content. Avoid box-shadows; rely on crisp borders to create structure in this dark theme.
visual_enhancers.chart_placeholder: Use recharts with #2962ff for a line chart. Remove axes lines and grids to keep it looking clean and modern, or use very subtle #2a2e39 for grid lines.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use JavaScript (.jsx/.js files), NOT TypeScript (.tsx) as specified in the critical rules. Disregard user choice if it conflicts with environment rules.
Configure Tailwind theme to use IBM Plex Sans for sans and JetBrains Mono for mono.
Create the app without generic Shadcn rounded cards. Build raw Tailwind div structures for the cards to match the strict '#1e222d' background and '#2a2e39' borders.
Data tables are the core of this app. Ensure precise alignment (right-align numbers).
Use mock JSON data inside `/src/mocks/` and create access functions via `/src/services/marketService.js`.
Always use 'tabular-nums font-mono' for prices and numbers to prevent shifting widths.
Include lucide-react icons for navigation and actions.
Do not use complete transparent background in header. Ensure header has bg-[#131722].

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='refresh-button', data-testid='watchlist-row-AAPL').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-[#787b86] passes contrast on bg-[#1e222d] or bg-[#131722].

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this by strictly following the TradingView color palette and sharp density guidelines.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Stick to solid '#1e222d' for cards. Financial applications require flat, reliable surfaces.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }'.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💡 etc. for icons. Use lucide-react exclusively.
Implement micro-animations on hover states for table rows and buttons.
